data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Pacific Ridge's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in ALCO, PKBK, and FSBW.

On September 24, PKBK disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1315399/000143774926031135/pkbk20260923_8k.htm).

Would you like the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
